spellbook.finance/limitations: This lists real product for sale on the selected marketplace. A buyer can purchase it.
Call spellbook_sealed_listing_preview first, every time, and show the person the quantity and ask before this call.
feature_disabled with status 409 means sealed listing is not turned on for this account yet. Nothing was sent. Tell the person, and do not retry.
agent_marketplace_publish_disabled with status 403 means delegated marketplace publishing is switched off. Nothing was sent.
sealed_publication_stale_stock or sealed_publication_stale_intent means inventory moved since the preview. Preview again and show the person the new proposal.
With priceRule undercut, submit reads the TCGplayer listings again. sealed_publication_stale_price means a competitor moved the ask. Preview again and show the person the new ask.
The returned intent.priceDecision is the undercut decision stamped at submit.
manapool_sealed_sales_disabled means the ManaPool account has payouts or sealed sales turned off. The seller fixes that at ManaPool.
state pending means the marketplace write is not confirmed by an exact readback. Do not tell the person it is live.
After a TCGplayer submit or pause, call spellbook_sealed_listing_preview again. Report live only when publisher.state is live; a confirmed zero quantity is removed.
TCGplayer publisher readback confirms its listing quantity and ask. It does not confirm that a later TCGplayer sealed sale was imported into physical inventory.
Call spellbook_sealed_listing_pause to remove a SpellBook-managed offer.

description: Submit one sealed product listing to ManaPool or TCGplayer at the exact quantity and ask shown by spellbook_sealed_listing_preview. Pass the same channel and product arguments, plus proposed.stockRevision, proposed.askUsd, and intentRevision unchanged. ManaPool submits directly. TCGplayer queues the paired browser writer. A queued TCG write is pending until an exact seller-grid readback confirms it.

boxId.description: The TCGplayer product id of the sealed product, the boxId on a spellbook_sealed_portfolio row. Required.

cap.description: The most units to offer at once. Omit to offer every eligible unit.

channel.description: Marketplace to submit to. Must match the preview. Defaults to manapool.

expectedAskUsd.description: proposed.askUsd from the preview. Required; a different value means the market ask changed and the call is refused.

expectedIntentRevision.description: intentRevision from the preview. Pass it unchanged, null included.

expectedStockRevision.description: proposed.stockRevision from the preview. Required; a different value means stock moved and the call is refused.

fixedPriceUsd.description: A fixed ask in USD for every unit. Omit to list at the product's current market price. Cannot be combined with priceRule.

floorMarketFraction.description: undercut only. The floor as a fraction of catalog market, used when floorUsd is omitted. Defaults to 0.9.

floorUsd.description: undercut only. The lowest ask in USD the rule may choose. Omit to use catalog market times floorMarketFraction.

game.description: The game of the product. Defaults to mtg.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique request key for this publish attempt, such as a new UUID. If the result is uncertain, preview current state before deciding on another submit. Required.

kind.description: The sealed kind, the kind on the same spellbook_sealed_portfolio row. Required, because units are counted by kind and boxId together.

language.description: The product language code, such as EN or JA. Defaults to EN.

priceRule.description: market asks the catalog market price. undercut sets the ask so the item plus the seller's own shipping lands one cent under the cheapest TCGplayer item plus shipping from another seller, never below the floor. Omit for market.

takeover.description: True adopts a listing on the selected marketplace that SpellBook did not create. Defaults to false; pass true only after the person agrees.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that holds the sealed units, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_listing_submit
